name: AbuseIPDB - Inbound Network Traffic from Blacklisted IP
description: Detects repeated inbound network connections (>= 5 in 1 hour) from an AbuseIPDB blacklisted IP (score >= 75) as seen by firewalls, proxies, or IDS/IPS devices reporting to CommonSecurityLog. Indicates active scanning, exploitation attempts, or persistent C2 from known malicious infrastructure.
query:
let HighConfidenceIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= 75
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where SourceIP in ((HighConfidenceIPs | project IpAddress))
| summarize
    ConnectionCount = count(),
    DistinctDestinations = dcount(DestinationIP),
    DestPorts = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    Devices = make_set(strcat(DeviceVendor, ' - ', DeviceProduct), 5),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by SourceIP
| where ConnectionCount >= 5
| join kind=inner HighConfidenceIPs on $left.SourceIP == $right.IpAddress
| project SourceIP, ConnectionCount, DistinctDestinations, DestPorts, AbuseScore, Country, Devices, FirstSeen, LastSeen
